description: At least one definitive walk-forward fold must exist.
Fold IDs must be sequential and deterministic.
Every out-of-sample month must be tested exactly once.
Out-of-sample test dates must advance strictly through time.
Every completed modeling month from the first OOS date onward must be tested.
Train, validation and test dates must be mutually exclusive inside each fold.
Every fold must satisfy train < validation < test.
Every fold must satisfy the configured minimum training history.
Every fold must contain the configured number of validation dates.
Every OOS month must contain the complete security universe.
Historical OOS test rows must have completed targets for evaluation.
Train and validation targets must be fully known by the test date.
Expanding mode must preserve previously eligible training history.
Persisted Step 12A fold metadata must match the regenerated walk-forward contract.
Step 12B preprocessing results must align one-to-one with the OOS folds.
Every fold must account for all candidate features using training-only availability.
No active predictor may remain missing after fold-local preprocessing.
Preprocessed features must not contain positive or negative infinity.
Non-constant continuous training features must be centered and scaled using training-only statistics.
